title: Panoptes 0.1.0
text: Added validated, authoritative database-platform declaration. Added canonical DBMS selection enabled/required semantics. Added normalized HADES_* environment resolution explicit legacy aliases redacted printing. Added DatabaseConnector adapters SQLite, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, Redshift, Spark, BigQuery, Snowflake, IRIS. Added stable panoptes_database_test_context, scoped temporary BigQuery key files SqlRender options, explicit live connection verification. Added collision-resistant object names static workflow drift validation. Simplified live CI one complete pull-request/manual matrix; Panoptes scheduled tier matrix-derivation API. prototype ci declaration field rejected unknown. Added package templates, JSON Schema, unit tests, vignettes, maintainer documentation. Expanded consumer vignette end--end maintainer guide covering declaration, behavior tests, local execution, protected environments, CI, rollout, troubleshooting.
